name: Can I remove a load-bearing wall during a kitchen reconfiguration?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove a load-bearing wall during a kitchen reconfiguration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a load-bearing wall during a kitchen reconfiguration is possible but requires professional assessment and structural modifications. A structural engineer must determine if the wall is load-bearing and design an appropriate support system, typically involving a new beam or header. This work is complex and directly impacts your home's structural integrity, requiring specific permits and careful execution. Never attempt to remove a load-bearing wall without professional guidance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it requires professional assessment by a structural engineer, a new support system, and specific permits due to structural impact.
